features.summary: Firefox replaced its old online Web Speech recognition path with local, on-device recognition based on the Parakeet engine, the HWInference process, and downloadable models managed through ModelHub. The Web Speech API now has more complete standards behavior, including locale-based model selection, `continuous` recognition, model availability and installation, permission prompts with download progress, AI Controls and Permissions Policy checks, and accurate result, confidence, timing, stop, and abort events. patches.subject: Don't warn when GMP storage directory doesn't exist during ClearStorage.

features.summary: Gecko Media Plugins (GMP), Firefox’s system for running media plugins, now passes a child process’s module list through a shared-memory section handle and uses clearer module-identifier naming. It also avoids a warning when clearing plugin storage that does not exist; these are mainly reliability and maintenance changes.

features.label: HTMLMediaElement

patches.author: Jan-Niklas Jaeschke
patches.subject: Part 3: Rename nsRange to mozilla::dom::Range.

patches.author: Jan-Niklas Jaeschke
patches.subject: Part 1: Rename nsRange.{h,cpp} to mozilla/dom/Range.{h,cpp}.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Fix mCurrentPlayRangeStart sentinel default so HTMLMediaElement.played is tracked correctly.

patches.author: Emilio Cobos Álvarez
patches.subject: Rename IsAttributeMapped to IsNoNamespaceAttrMapped.

features.summary: Firefox now tracks the range of media an HTMLMediaElement has actually played more accurately, so its `played` property can report the right intervals. The other changes rename internal range and attribute helpers without changing the visible web interface.

features.label: Media Capabilities

patches.author: az
patches.subject: Part 2: Avoid routing record MediaCapabilities queries through WebRTC encoder factories.

patches.author: az
patches.subject: Part 1: Split the smooth heuristic out of IsWebRTCSWEncodeSmooth so the record type can reuse it.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Route MediaCapabilities decoder creation through PDMFactorySupport::IsSupportedAsync to ensure remote processes have reported their supported codecs.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Downgrade expected missing-compositor NS_WARN_IF to a debug LOG in MediaCapabilities::GetCompositor.

features.summary: Media Capabilities now separates the smooth-playback heuristic from WebRTC encoder checks so recording queries can reuse it without being routed through WebRTC factories. Decoder capability requests also go through the asynchronous platform support path, ensuring remote processes report their available codecs before Firefox answers whether a format is supported.

features.label: Media sink

patches.author: Thomas Nibler
patches.subject: Reset SPSC producer thread on AudioSink reuse

patches.author: Gregory Pappas
patches.subject: Persist stream name in PlaybackParams

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Convert underrun NS_WARNING to SINK_LOG in AudioSink::PopFrames.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 1: Drop queued pre-seek audio when stopping a reused stream.

features.summary: AudioSink now drops audio queued before a seek when a playback stream is stopped and reused, preventing stale sound from carrying into playback afterward. Reuse also resets the audio producer thread correctly, while underrun reporting is made less noisy and stream names persist across playback settings.

features.label: Web Audio

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Fix intermittent test failure in dom/media/webaudio/test/test_audioContextGC.html.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Remove AudioContext::GetMainThread().

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Fix typo in SSE4.2 configuration handling

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Handle promise rejection from repeated OfflineAudioContext.startRendering() calls in fuzzer crashtest.

features.summary: Web Audio received small reliability fixes: a flaky AudioContext garbage-collection test is addressed, and repeated calls to `OfflineAudioContext.startRendering()` are handled more safely when they reject. The remaining changes remove an obsolete thread accessor and correct an SSE4.2 configuration typo.

features.label: Autoplay

patches.author: Calvin Lei-Cramer
patches.subject: fix typo.

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Remove test.wait300msAfterTabSwitch from remaining tests that already pass without it. ,necko-reviewers,media-playback-reviewers,layout-reviewers,padenot,valentin,dshin,Gijs

features.summary: The autoplay area received test maintenance only: a typo was corrected and unnecessary waits after switching tabs were removed from tests that no longer need them. _There is no intended user-facing behavior change_; the suite should simply run faster and more reliably.

features.label: WebCodecs

patches.author: Chun-Min Chang
patches.subject: Log colorspace in full-cycle path

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Make shallow copy of VideoFrame to prevent caller from closing ImageDecoder's copies.

features.summary: WebCodecs now logs color-space information through its full encode/decode cycle, helping diagnose color handling in applications that manipulate VideoFrame objects. ImageDecoder also makes shallow copies of its VideoFrame results so a caller closing one frame cannot accidentally invalidate copies still owned by the decoder.

features.label: Driftcontrol

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Get rid of collections.OrderedDict

features.summary: Driftcontrol was simplified by removing a dependency on Python’s collections.OrderedDict, relying on the regular dictionary behavior available in supported Python versions. This is an internal maintenance change with no visible browser feature impact.

features.label: Encrypted Media (EME / DRM)

patches.author: Exploding-Joysticks
patches.subject: Remove the media.eme.encrypted-media-encryption-scheme.enabled pref

features.summary: Firefox removed the preference controlling the encrypted-media encryption-scheme feature in Encrypted Media Extensions (EME), the web API used for DRM-protected video and audio. The setting is no longer needed, simplifying configuration while leaving supported DRM playback behavior unchanged.

features.label: Media Control / Session

patches.author: Sugarycandybar
patches.subject: Pick largest MediaMetadata artwork sizes first.

features.summary: Firefox now prefers the largest artwork images supplied through MediaMetadata, the web feature that provides a page’s media title and artwork to browser controls. This helps platform media controls show a sharper image when several sizes are available.

features.label: Media Control / Session

patches.author: Stephen A Pohl
patches.subject: Don't report a non-finite media duration to the platform media controls.

features.summary: Firefox no longer sends an unknown or infinite media duration to the operating system’s media controls. This avoids controls showing confusing or invalid playback times for streams that don’t have a fixed length.

features.label: Media Source Extensions (MSE)

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Silence expected AbortError from removeNodeAndSource()/cleanup teardown aborting a pending play() promise in media mochitests.

features.summary: Media Source Extensions (MSE) mochitests now treat an AbortError caused by tearing down a media source during a pending play() as expected, rather than as a noisy warning. This makes test results clearer without changing playback behavior.

features.label: Ogg

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Downgrade expected single-page Opus end-trimming NS_WARNING to a debug LOG in OggCodecState.

features.summary: Ogg playback now logs an expected end-trimming condition for single-page Opus files at debug level instead of raising a warning. This reduces misleading diagnostic noise while preserving useful information for developers.

features.label: Tools

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Teach GMP scripts to generate yml for Widevine artifacts used in CI.

features.summary: Firefox’s Widevine DRM build scripts can now generate the YAML files needed to use Widevine artifacts in continuous-integration testing. This improves automated checks for the protected-media component without changing what users see.
